messages:
Sophie: Quick cross-team check — we're green to start the v2 API cutover smoke next week but we need owners locked for a few items: SDK patch, routing fallback, infra shim, canary dashboard, and docs/migration note. Who can take which?

Tariq: I'll take routing fallback (eng-runtime). Need ETA from infra for token propagation shims and the auth header fallback. @Kevin can you confirm infra timeline? :eyes:

Kevin: I can own the infra shim. Plan to open the PR EOD Tue, tests Wed. Will need a prod-like loadgen for the full flow — @Lucas can you reshare the harness we used for the last cutover?

Lucas: Yep — link: https://go/internal/load-tests/v2-harness. Also dropping the quick run command we used:
```
./run_load.sh --model=gpt-small --rps=150 --seq=512
```
I can spin a run after PR merges.

Sophie: SDK patch is needed to expose an opt-in header and emit a deprecation warning when hitting v1 endpoints. Maria, can you own SDK? Keep it minor semver and add a migration snippet to docs.

Maria: I can take SDK. Plan: minor release with opt-in header `X-RW-V2`, plus a warning when requests still go to the v1 path. PR by Tue, tests Wed. I need the final API contract fields before the PR — @Tariq can you post the final names?

Tariq: Contract is stable. New response fields are `compat_vector` and `deprecated_path` header for routing hints. Routing fallback will map unknown calls to a v1-compatible model variant; I'll post a short spec gist in a minute.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: 2025-06-16T02:00Z — monitor channel #eng-runtime. :robot_face:

Sophie: Docs & migration note — I'll draft the migration doc and ping docs reviewers. Can we agree on a smoke acceptance checklist? Suggested: 1) E2E request returns expected fields, 2) SDK flag toggles behavior, 3) latency SLO within 20% of v1, 4) no increase in tail error-rate > 1%.

Kevin: Sounds good. Who owns rollback? If canary shows error-rate > 1% we should revert automatically. Maria, can the SDK release include a feature-flag cancel endpoint so on-call can flip it?

Maria: Yes — I'll add a rollback toggle in the release PR and wire an endpoint to flip the SDK opt-in. Also adding metrics to the PR: `v2_error_rate`, `v2_latency_p50`, `v2_latency_p95` so ops can alert.

Lucas: I'll run the harness once SDK + routing + infra PRs are merged. Ping me on the PR thread and I'll queue the load job.

Sophie: Recap owners: SDK -> Maria; routing/kv-cache -> Tariq; infra shim -> Kevin; load harness -> Lucas; docs/migration -> Sophie. I'll create an owner checklist doc with tasks and due-dates and share the link here. :thumbsup:

Tariq: Ack. I'll post the routing spec shortly.

Maria: Ack. Will target Tue PR and add the rollback toggle.

Kevin: Ack. PR by EOD Tue. Will coordinate infra tests with Lucas.

Lucas: Ack, standing by for PRs.

Sophie: Thanks all — I'll post the checklist and a short timeline (canary start, monitoring window, rollback criteria) in ~30m.
